tokens.name: gallery-ivory
tokens.usage: Text on dark surfaces, label on accent fills, and panels. No longer the main light background (see cinematic-white). Carbon on it 14.2:1; Aubergine 11.5:1.

tokens.name: cinematic-white
tokens.usage: Main bright page background (light theme), from the live site. Carbon on it 15.1:1; Aubergine 12.2:1; Warm Grey 5.6:1; Oxide 5.5:1.

tokens.name: carbon
tokens.usage: Main text (light theme) and dark surfaces (dark theme). Ivory on it 14.2:1. Also the ink of the dark wordmark.

tokens.name: parchment
tokens.usage: Secondary backgrounds in the light theme; muted text on dark surfaces. Carbon on it 12.4:1; Warm Grey only 4.4:1, so no grey text on parchment.

tokens.name: aubergine
tokens.usage: Signature accent and primary buttons. Ivory on it 11.5:1. One dominant accent per layout; aubergine is that accent.

tokens.name: warm-grey
tokens.usage: Secondary text on cinematic-white only (5.6:1). Below 4.5:1 on parchment (4.4:1), and not legible on carbon: do not use there.

tokens.name: oxide
tokens.usage: Occasional editorial accent, optional and never a second compulsory accent. 5.5:1 on cinematic-white; not legible on carbon.

tokens.name: antique-brass
tokens.usage: Decorative details and print finishing only: hairlines and rules. Never a default text colour.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Carbon on cinematic-white 15.1:1; ivory on carbon 14.2:1.

tokens.name: bg-alt
tokens.usage: Secondary background: panels, bands, cards. Light: parchment; dark: aubergine (use for one panel per layout, as the dominant accent).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg and bg-alt (carbon on parchment 12.4:1; ivory on aubergine 11.5:1).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg only: warm grey on ivory 5.3:1; parchment on carbon 12.4:1. On bg-alt use text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill in both themes. Ivory label on it 11.5:1. One dominant accent per layout.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label colour on an accent fill (ivory on aubergine, 11.5:1).

tokens.name: accent-edge
tokens.usage: 1px edge of the primary button. In the dark theme brass keeps the aubergine fill distinct from carbon; decorative, the label carries the meaning.

tokens.name: accent-editorial
tokens.usage: Optional editorial accent for kickers and links on bg: oxide 5.2:1 on ivory. Oxide is not legible on carbon, so the dark theme uses parchment; underline links in both.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px rules and dividers on every surface. Decorative; never carries meaning alone.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and outlined buttons: warm grey 5.3:1 on ivory (4.4:1 on parchment); parchment on carbon 12.4:1.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline: aubergine on ivory 11.5:1 and parchment 9.6:1; ivory on carbon 14.2:1 and aubergine 11.5:1.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headline, 48–88px responsive. Playfair Display regular, sentence case.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headline, small end of the range.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Italic is an occasional accent: selected quotations and the master slogan. Never for whole headlines.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The initial flash of an idea, feeling, image, or encounter.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a headline. Poppins Regular.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.sample: A creative spark made tangible through art.
styles.usage: Semibold only where hierarchy requires it, for example the first line of a definition.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Credits and image captions, 13–14px. Credit every artist and image-maker.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Navigation and short labels. Poppins Medium; uppercase only for short labels.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels in sentence case: "Discuss a project". Poppins Medium.

spacing.note: Gutter from the live site: clamp(1.25rem, 3.2vw, 3.25rem). The rest of the scale is provisional.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between related elements.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of buttons; card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and its body.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between components in a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on small screens.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on large screens.

tokens.name: gutter-min
tokens.usage: Page side padding on narrow screens; the lower bound of the site's gutter clamp(1.25rem, 3.2vw, 3.25rem).

tokens.name: gutter-max
tokens.usage: Page side padding on wide screens; the upper bound of the site's gutter.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Buttons, panels, images and inputs: every corner on the brand board is square. The arch is a drawn outline, not a corner radius.
